title: Week 4 Analysis
subtitle: The AFC East fell into place, and Cadegn ran away with it.
intro_paragraphs: A week after everybody's total dropped, everybody's total went up. Most of that came from one division: the AFC East finished Week 4 exactly in chalk order (Bills, Patriots, Jets, Dolphins), and six of the seven bettors had picked it that way.

fun_facts.heading: Cadegn Goes From 4th to 1st
fun_facts.body: Cadegn was up 39 points to 65, the second-biggest one-week jump of the season after Dilger's +46 in Week 2, going from 4th to a 20-point lead. Two perfect divisions did it. The AFC East paid off like it did for almost everybody else, and Cadegn's NFC East pick paid off too: Giants, Eagles, Cowboys, Commanders, exactly how the division stands now. The Giants at 3-1 make Cadegn the only bettor in the pool who picked them to win the division.

fun_facts.heading: Tom's Perfect Division Changed Hands
fun_facts.body: Tom's NFC East was perfect last week with the Eagles first and the Giants second. Now that the Giants have passed Philadelphia, his 25 points there dropped to 8. Thanks to the AFC East he still gained 8 points overall and holds 2nd at 45, but Hume is only 2 behind him. Dilger and Dustin are tied at 40 and are still tied after the first four tiebreakers.

fun_facts.heading: Farmer Missed the Big AFC East Payoff
fun_facts.body: Farmer was the only bettor who didn't pick the AFC East perfectly. They had the Dolphins third and the Jets fourth, one swap away, so they got +9 there instead of +25. That left them in last place at 36, one point behind Mike T. They still have 11 exact slot hits, the second-most in the pool, so the picks are mostly right. The payoff just hasn't come yet.

fun_facts.heading: The Locks Bounced Back, Except the Rams
fun_facts.body:
4 of the 8 preseason unanimous picks are holding, up from 2 last week. Pittsburgh is back in third in the AFC North, and New England has second in the AFC East again. Buffalo first in the AFC East is now 4 for 4 and is still the only lock that has never broken.

The Rams are 0 for 4. The 49ers are 4-0 and running the NFC West, while the pool's most unanimous division-winner pick is 2-2 in third. The AFC North shows how much things move around: the Browns, picked unanimously to finish last, are 3-1 and lead the division on a tiebreaker over Baltimore.

fun_facts.heading: Nobody Saw These Division Leaders Coming
fun_facts.body: Four divisions are being led by teams nobody in the pool picked to win: the Browns, Vikings (4-0), Panthers, and 49ers. Every bettor's division-winner picks are 3 for 8 or worse. Cadegn is the best at 3 of 8, and Dilger, Dustin, and Tom are each at 1 of 8, the Bills.

closing_paragraph: One chalk division moved the whole leaderboard, and Cadegn is the only one who got a second division to fall into place too. A 20-point lead after four weeks is real, but Tom had a perfect division last week and lost it this week. Same time next Tuesday.
